name: content_moderation_categories
description: Harm categories for content moderation dataset generation. Used both to filter existing datasets and to drive generation loops over categories.

Physical Harm.description: Content depicting, promoting, or instructing physical violence, threats, or bodily harm

CBRN.description: Content related to chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear threats

Cyber.description: Content enabling cyberattacks, exploitation, or unauthorized system access

Privacy.description: Content exposing, seeking, or facilitating access to private personal information

Harmful Manipulation.description: Content designed to deceive, manipulate, or psychologically exploit individuals or groups

Self-Harm.description: Content promoting or instructing self-harm or suicide

Hate Speech.description: Content targeting protected groups with hostility or discrimination

Illegal Activities.description: Content promoting or instructing illegal actions not covered by other categories

Harm to Minors.description: Content harmful to, exploiting, or endangering minors

Information Integrity.description: Deliberately false, misleading, or fabricated content that undermines trust in information
